metricDefinitions.label: Pipeline stage status
metricDefinitions.definition: Outcome of a bounded, locally executed validation step.

source.label: Process and host resource profiler
caveats: CPU and RSS cover the process tree; GPU and VRAM are host-level samples and can overlap other GPU workloads.
Smoke training used four windows and one optimizer step; it is not a full-dataset duration estimate.

metricDefinitions.label: Peak CPU cores
metricDefinitions.definition: Peak process-tree CPU percent divided by 100.

metricDefinitions.label: GPU VRAM delta
metricDefinitions.definition: Peak sampled host GPU memory minus the pre-command baseline.

source.label: CUDA segmentation benchmark
caveats: The first GPU feature batch includes JIT/kernel warm-up; steady-state measurements exclude that first batch.

source.label: WIFI-GUARD live host monitor
caveats: This is one point-in-time host snapshot, not a workload-isolated profile.
Disk utilization is 92.5% and requires cleanup or expansion before long retention runs.

metricDefinitions.label: Host utilization
metricDefinitions.definition: Direct host telemetry sampled by psutil and nvidia-smi.

source.label: AWS-neutral sizing envelope
caveats: Recommendations apply 1.5x headroom and retain ten checkpoints.
Storage excludes Kafka retention, logs, backups and future datasets.
No AWS instance type, region price or concurrency claim is made.

metricDefinitions.label: Recommended capacity
metricDefinitions.definition: Rounded resource envelope derived from measured local peaks with 1.5x headroom.

source.label: AWS Seoul monthly planning estimate
caveats: Estimates assume 730 hours/month, 24×7 operation, 15% contingency, and a planning rate of 1 USD = 1,400 KRW.
Network, load balancing, DNS, and request costs are scenario allowances because final topology and traffic are unknown.
Taxes, Support plans, device concurrency growth, and live exchange-rate movement are excluded.

metricDefinitions.label: Monthly base cost
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of modeled AWS unit prices and explicit scenario usage assumptions before contingency.

metricDefinitions.label: Monthly buffered cost
metricDefinitions.definition: Monthly base cost multiplied by 1.15 for planning uncertainty.

rows.note: One 24×7 GPU node; dominant pilot cost

source.label: AWS Price List for Asia Pacific (Seoul)
caveats: Rates can change; refresh the estimator or AWS Pricing Calculator before purchase.
Reserved pricing requires a one-year commitment and is shown only as sensitivity.

metricDefinitions.label: Modeled monthly cost
metricDefinitions.definition: Unit price multiplied by the quantity shown in the planning scenario.

source.label: Imported package manifest and registry
caveats: The checkpoint file remains an external runtime artifact and is intentionally excluded from Git.

metricDefinitions.label: Model inventory
metricDefinitions.definition: Identity and bounded size metadata for the imported model package.
